nodes.name: Safe Practice Space Check
nodes.objective: With a parent, identify and clear hazards before beginning a session.
nodes.whyItMatters: This capability supports safe, controlled and transferable basketball movement.
nodes.parentInstructions: Use the demonstration, give only the listed cues and stop when control deteriorates.
safety: A parent must confirm the practice area is clear.

drills.name: Safe Space Scan
drills.purpose: Practise safe space scan in a controlled, repeatable format.
instructions: Walk around the practice area with an adult.
Move hazards out of the area.
drills.parentRole: Set up the space, demonstrate once, then use only the listed cues.
safety: Stop if pain or unsafe loss of control occurs.

drills.name: Ready, Move, Stop and Freeze
drills.purpose: Practise ready, move, stop and freeze in a controlled, repeatable format.
instructions: Stop and hold balance for two seconds.
drills.parentRole: Set up the space, demonstrate once, then use only the listed cues.
safety: Stop if pain or unsafe loss of control occurs.

evidenceInstructions.framing: Full body and ball visible from the front or slight angle.

scaleAnchors.3: Stable for most of each interval
Both sides meet the drill standard
scaleAnchors.4: Both sides controlled with eyes forward

scaleAnchors.1: Bent over and watches ball continuously
scaleAnchors.3: Neutral posture with regular forward vision

evidenceInstructions.format: Coach-led station assessment with parent present.

scaleAnchors.3: Identifies and acts on simple choice

campaigns.name: Foundation Campaign 1 — Control First
campaigns.description: A prescribed cross-domain introduction to safety, movement, bilateral ball control, passing, shooting and simple decisions.
